left.raw_text:
Inclusion Criteria:
  -  Women called back from a screening mammography  [AND] by either FFDM  [OR] or tomosynthesis with soft tissue abnormalities including masses, [OR]  asymmetries, [OR]  focal asymmetries  [OR] or architectural distortion with  [OR] or without calcifications
Patients will be questioned regarding the possibility of pregnancy  [AND] and will need a negative pregnancy test prior the study intervention

right.raw_text:
Exclusion Criteria:
  -  Age <30 years old
  -  Screening mammography with only calcifications abnormalities
  -  Male patients
  -  Pregnant  [OR] or lactating patients
  -  Patients with any allergy to iodinated contrast
  -  Patients with eGFR < 45
  -  Patients that may be treated with radioactive iodine
